# id: # Hitpoints: trained by every combat style at a third of the style rate (1.33 xp per damage against 4); the melee rows carry that third.

name: Witch's House
note: Rewards 6,325 Hitpoints xp as a one-off; no requirements; the last two Witch's experiment forms can be safespotted with Magic; the pay-to-play guide recommends it first for a Hitpoints safety margin.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Hitpoints 2026-11-11

name: Gemstone Crab
note: Hitpoints xp comes with every combat style: 1.33 per damage against 4 in the style skill, so a third of the rate. Effectively infinite Hitpoints, 87.5% xp per hit but no overkill waste; crab relocates every 10 minutes and up to 16 players benefit; no xp/hr given.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Ironman Guide/Melee; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Ammonite Crabs
note: Hitpoints xp comes with every combat style: 1.33 per damage against 4 in the style skill, so a third of the rate. Highest-Hitpoints crab per the UIM guide; aggressive for 10 minutes; drops fossils; Bone Voyage needed for Fossil Island; the Ironman guide says xp is slightly lower than gemstone crabs; no xp/hr given.
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee; Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Nightmare Zone
note: Hitpoints xp comes with every combat style: 1.33 per damage against 4 in the style skill, so a third of the rate. Ironman guide gives about 70,000 xp/hr with mid-game ironman gear at base 70 melee (up to 85,000 on the boss list); pay-to-play page gives no rate; dreams cost a coin fee; absorption potions used for the normal rumble.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Ironman Guide/Melee; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Sulphur Naguas
note: Hitpoints xp comes with every combat style: 1.33 per damage against 4 in the style skill, so a third of the rate. Pay-to-play summary gives 75k xp/hr at 60 Strength and 130k at 75 Strength with full Blood Moon set and Piety; Ironman guide says 140k with Piety, 110k without; moonlight potions need no other supplies; dual macuahuitl needs 70 Attack and 75 Strength per the Ironman guide.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Scurrius
note: Hitpoints xp comes with every combat style: 1.33 per damage against 4 in the style skill, so a third of the rate. Pay-to-play guide says "100k+" xp/hr soloing the group variant with a bone mace at base-70 combat stats (the 100000 here is a lower bound); needs 40 Prayer; drops only cover supplies.

name: Maniacal monkeys with Hallowfell
note: Hitpoints xp comes with every combat style: 1.33 per damage against 4 in the style skill, so a third of the rate. Needs partial Monkey Madness II and Hallowfell (75 Attack); pay-to-play guide gives "200k xp/hr or more" with good stacking and crystal halberd specials, up to 300k with very strong strength gear.

name: Gargoyles
note: Hitpoints xp comes with every combat style: 1.33 per damage against 4 in the style skill, so a third of the rate. Needs 75 Slayer, a rock hammer and Priest in Peril; Guthan's equipment recommended; wiki gives no xp/hr and says the xp rate is substantially lower than other options; earnings upwards of 700k gp/hr.
